card.name: Words just before the word element
card.fires_on: Small words and adjectives right before a likely 'element' or 'elements', such as 'the', 'or', 'metallic', 'essential' and 'chemical'. It is strongest in chemistry text on the periodic table and chemical elements.

modes.label: Chemistry setting
modes.description: A word that leads into 'element' when describing a chemical element or its properties.
modes.example: a heavy brittle diamagnetic trivalent<< metallic>> element (resembles arsenic and ant

modes.label: Linking word before element
modes.description: A small word such as 'the' or 'or' where 'element' or 'periodic table' is expected next.
modes.example: did for<< the>> periodic table. He is able to transform

modes.label: Non-chemistry use
modes.description: An adjective like 'essential' or 'graphical' that could be followed by 'element' in general writing.
modes.example: only includes the<< essential>> figures of the Virgin and Saint John.

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'element' in several forms, so it lowers the chance that 'element' comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before the word 'element' is expected, mostly in chemistry text.
